content: Where is the wisdom we have lost in knowledge? Where is the knowledge we have lost in information?
author: T.S. Eliot
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

T.S. Eliot understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
